fields.System.Title: OUT-702 — Order tracking endpoint
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want a fast endpoint returning order progress, so that a
customer-facing page can show where a delivery has got to.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order reference, then the endpoint returns state, progress, carrier, and
  • tracking reference in one read.
  • - Given the response, then it includes last_updated_at so the caller can judge
  • freshness.
  • - Given several order references, then they can be requested in one call.
  • - Given an unknown reference, then 404 is returned without revealing whether the order
  • ever existed.
  • - Given the endpoint, then it reads only the projection and never joins the
  • transactional tables.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | order_status projection |
| Risks | Staleness invisible to the reader ([doc 08 §5.3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
